response.justification: Bogdan has strong distributed systems and high-throughput architecture experience, particularly with micro-services at Dunnhumby and real-time data handling. However, his recent role at re:cinq focuses on AI-agent infrastructure rather than core distributed systems, and his background lacks clear evidence of deep Python expertise or hands-on operational ownership in large-scale systems. His non-technical skills are strong, but the alignment with AI-native engineering environments and stakeholder management at scale needs verification.
strengths: Extensive experience with distributed systems and micro-services at high scale (Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated ability to design and maintain platform-level tools (GISCollective, MCP frameworks)
Strong background in agile practices, CI/CD, and trunk-based development
concerns: Limited evidence of deep Python expertise, with recent roles focusing on TypeScript and Node.js
No explicit experience with AI-driven code production or agentic systems beyond tooling
Operational ownership and on-call rotation experience not clearly highlighted
